standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
family: episteme C01–C64 (canonical concepts), carried in roz-c-concepts-1 and roz-c-concepts-2
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-concept (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: the C family is instituted knowledge as a lattice: each concept one addressable scene on the episteme print ground, one governing formation shaped by the concept's own operation, one definitional card

grammar.shares: one construction repeated 64 times; per-scene variation only in the governing formation, its support entities, and one or two field params

entities.governing_formation: one per scene, shaped by the concept's operation (ring of appearing, cut, sealed square, broken token, merged disc, focal disc with satellites…); the record's own notation may appear as a short text glyph only where the record states it (C48 '0/1', C49 '/', C03 '/')
entities.support_entities: at most 4 besides the governing formation, and only where the record's declared structure carries them; 6 of 64 scenes use a pin as a gather point
entities.entity_ceiling: never more than 10 formations per scene (native field import limit; 6 is this family's max)

text_layers.editorial_card: one layer at (0.033, 0.055, w 470, size 27): kicker '<record id> · <CLAIM_STATUS uppercase>' · title = record title · italic = declared relations (argument_consumers, concept links, source_ids — capped with '+n more'; exact lists live in the binding)
text_layers.body: one layer at (0.033, 0.455, w 620, size 15): the record's governing proposition, compressed from the record's own opening only, no new claims

status_encoding.note: presentation-only encoding of the record's frontmatter claim_status; a repeated colour association is never a claimed source relation

variation_rules: per-scene variation is explicit and small: formation shape/support, one or two field params (e.g. cymatic scenes slow speed to 0.3)
notation tokens appear only where the record's own notation is load-bearing
no ornament without an argumentative job; a quiet concept stays quiet
